import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import numpy as np
import torch
from world_model_rl.config import Config
from world_model_rl.data import Dataset
from world_model_rl.training import load_checkpoint
from world_model_rl.sac import SAC, real_replay
from world_model_rl.policy import policy_feature_size
from world_model_rl.teachers import geometry_actions

torch.set_num_threads(2)
cfg = Config.load('runs/town01_prototype_008/config.json')
payload, model, norm, _ = load_checkpoint('runs/town01_prototype_008/agent.pt', cfg, 'cpu')
actors = {}
for run in ['007', '008']:
    other = torch.load(f'runs/town01_prototype_{run}/agent.pt', map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
    sac = SAC(policy_feature_size(model, cfg), cfg, 'cpu')
    sac.load_state_dict(other['sac'])
    sac.actor.eval()
    actors[run] = sac
report = {'purpose': 'Read-only action generalization audit. No gradients, optimization, checkpoint writes, or CARLA control.',
          'teacher': 'geometry_v3', 'splits': {}}
dataset = Dataset('runs/town01_training_data_001', cfg)
for split in ['train', 'validation']:
    episodes = dataset.load(split)
    replay = real_replay(episodes, model, norm, 'cpu', payload['model_version'], policy_skip=True)
    target = np.concatenate([geometry_actions(ep.arrays, True, True) for ep in episodes])
    continuous = np.concatenate([ep.arrays['continuous'][:-1] for ep in episodes])
    light = np.concatenate([ep.arrays['light'][:-1] for ep in episodes])
    controls = np.concatenate([ep.arrays['controls'][:-1] for ep in episodes])
    stopping = controls[:, 0] & np.isin(light, [2, 3]) & (continuous[:, 14] >= 0) & (continuous[:, 14] < 25) & (target[:, 2] > .1)
    categories = {'all': np.ones(len(target), bool), 'moving_red_braking': stopping & (continuous[:, 0] > .3),
                  'stationary_red_braking': stopping & (continuous[:, 0] <= .3),
                  'teacher_accelerating': target[:, 1] > .2, 'turns': np.abs(target[:, 0]) > .15}
    result = {'episode_ids': [ep.metadata['episode_id'] for ep in episodes], 'transitions': len(target), 'actors': {}}
    for name, sac in actors.items():
        features = replay.arrays['features']
        predictions = np.concatenate([sac.act(features[i:i + 1024], deterministic=True) for i in range(0, len(features), 1024)])
        # Reorder interchangeable vehicle slots and pedestrian slots together
        # with their masks/classes. This changes no physical scene or teacher label.
        sampled = features[::10].copy()
        original = predictions[::10]
        offset = cfg.model.deterministic + cfg.model.stochastic + 4
        permutation = np.r_[np.arange(5, -1, -1), np.arange(11, 5, -1)]
        sampled[:, offset + 30:offset + 114] = sampled[:, offset + 30:offset + 114].reshape(-1, 12, 7)[:, permutation].reshape(-1, 84)
        sampled[:, offset + 114:offset + 126] = sampled[:, offset + 114:offset + 126][:, permutation]
        sampled[:, offset + 126:offset + 162] = sampled[:, offset + 126:offset + 162].reshape(-1, 12, 3)[:, permutation].reshape(-1, 36)
        permuted = np.concatenate([sac.act(sampled[i:i + 1024], deterministic=True) for i in range(0, len(sampled), 1024)])
        result['actors'][name] = {'slot_permutation': {'sampled_states': len(sampled),
            'mean_absolute_action_change': np.abs(permuted - original).mean(0).tolist(),
            'braking_decision_changed_fraction': float(np.mean((original[:, 2] - original[:, 1] > .1) != (permuted[:, 2] - permuted[:, 1] > .1)))}}
        for category, mask in categories.items():
            pred, truth = predictions[mask], target[mask]
            result['actors'][name][category] = {'count': int(mask.sum()),
                'mean_absolute_action_error': np.abs(pred - truth).mean(0).tolist() if mask.any() else None,
                'net_braking_fraction': float(np.mean(pred[:, 2] - pred[:, 1] > .1)) if mask.any() else None,
                'net_throttle_fraction': float(np.mean(pred[:, 1] - pred[:, 2] > .1)) if mask.any() else None}
    report['splits'][split] = result
    print(split, json.dumps(result['actors']), flush=True)
out = Path('runs/town01_prototype_008/action_generalization_audit.json')
report['reproduction_source'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(out, flush=True)
